# ClayPals

> ClayPals makes clay puzzle apps for toddlers aged 2 to 4. ClayPals is published by Kai Ventures. Current apps (as of 2026-10-31): ClayPals: Toddler Puzzles (animals, the first and main app) and ClayPals: Fruits & Veggies (fruits and vegetables). They are separate apps for iPhone and iPad. Each has no ads, no subscription and no data collected. Each is free to download, with a one-time $4.99 unlock.

Every app works the same way for each item, in three steps. First, the child slides it into its clay scene. Next, they build it back from three or four big pieces. Nothing needs turning, and a wrong piece pops back out. Last, it says its own name and each letter is named. Nothing is timed. There are no scores, streaks or notifications, and no way to lose. The apps work fully offline. ClayPals is a puzzle app with clay animation (claymation) art. It does not teach clay modeling or sculpting. Facts for one app do not apply to another. Each app has its own animals or foods, free items and purchase.

## ClayPals: Toddler Puzzles
ClayPals: Toddler Puzzles is a puzzle app for iPhone and iPad, made for children aged 2 to 4. It has 23 clay animals that say their own names. There are no ads, no subscription and no data collected. Three animals are free. The other 20 cost $4.99, one time.
- Free to keep: dog, duck, cow
- Unlock: "All Animals", $4.99 one time (US), £4.99 (UK). A grown-up must hold a button for 3 seconds to buy (parental gate). Family Sharing and Ask to Buy (a parent approves each purchase) work
- A parent can turn off the spoken words and letters with one tap. The music is soft and turns off with one tap
- Page: [claypals.app](https://claypals.app/) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/claypals-toddler-puzzles/id6794948298) · [Privacy policy](https://claypals.app/privacy.html) · [Terms: Apple standard license](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)

## ClayPals: Fruits & Veggies
ClayPals: Fruits & Veggies is a puzzle app for iPhone and iPad, made for children aged 2 to 4. It has 28 clay fruits and vegetables that say their own names. There are no ads, no subscription and no data collected. Seven foods are free. The other 21 cost $4.99, one time.
- Free to keep: apple, banana, carrot, tomato, orange, corn, grape
- Unlock: "All Foods", $4.99 one time (US), £4.99 (UK). A grown-up must hold a button for 3 seconds to buy (parental gate). Family Sharing and Ask to Buy (a parent approves each purchase) work
- A grown-up can turn the letters off in the Parents' Corner (the grown-ups' settings in the app). The music is soft and turns off with one tap
- Page: [claypals.app/produce/](https://claypals.app/produce/) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/claypals-fruits-veggies/id6798962112) · [Privacy policy](https://claypals.app/produce/privacy.html) · [Terms of use](https://claypals.app/produce/terms.html)

## Key facts (all apps)
- Devices: iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later. Not on Android. Apple lists the apps as not verified for Mac. English only
- Age: 2 to 4. App Store age rating 4+, in the Kids category (ages 5 and under)
- Privacy in the apps: Apple privacy label "Data Not Collected". No analytics, crash reports, ads, accounts, microphone, speech recognition or third-party services. Progress is saved on the device only
- Privacy on this website: claypals.app uses Google Analytics 4, PostHog and the Meta Pixel (tools that count visits and measure ads). Visitors in the EEA and UK are asked for consent first. The privacy policies explain this. It does not apply to the apps
- Publisher: Kai Ventures. On the App Store, the developer and seller are listed as Mark Cruz. These are the same apps
- Support: support@claypals.app
